scope.purpose: Correct the two known PHB MediaBox-normalized frame projections in offline source-visual and raster-boundary consumers while preserving owner/catalog/source/image/focus/content pins and prior source-review assessments.

decision.idea: Use a narrow external, hash-bound source-frame registry. Resolve each registered normalized rectangle using its exact current PDF page boxes and owner/catalog/region/image/source pins.
decision.goal: Correct the known 11 PHB window projections without rewriting reviewed catalog objects or their manual reviews; preserve diagnostics outside the bounded correction set.
decision.context: PHB p.27 and p.37 CropBox/page.rect widths are 3.6 pt narrower than MediaBox. The known affected windows are MediaBox-normalized. Other verified crops can use CropBox/page.rect normalization, so there is no safe global transform. Historic renderer/DPI remains unknown.

alternativesConsidered.idea: Retain the page.rect assumption for all current normalized windows.
alternativesConsidered.result: Rejected for the 11 registered windows: old 300-DPI bounds were p.27 [1212,70,2345,700] and p.37 [83,114,2389,720], against corrected [1220,70,2360,700] and [84,114,2404,720].

alternativesConsidered.idea: Rewrite catalog rectangles or switch all normalized windows to MediaBox.
alternativesConsidered.result: Rejected: catalog/focus/content changes would invalidate existing reviews, and a global MediaBox transform would misproject CropBox-normalized records.

alternativesConsidered.idea: Automatically add all XP appends to the 9-frame registry.
alternativesConsidered.result: Rejected: the 13 additions span other pages/frames. The bridge refresh records them outside the original denominator; one exact p.27 CropBox candidate is pending independent approval.

decision.proof: Current source visual replay changes exactly 11 existing bound rectangles; all noncohort geometric/text-layer rows match the no-bridge current snapshot. The 102 review-hash/assessment tuples are unchanged.
